description: Land Acquisition - Irupalai, Valikamam East D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It involves the Minister of Lands directing the immediate possession of a specific land parcel (0.2339 Hectare) in Irupalai, Jaffna District, with detailed boundary descriptions. The content focuses on property acquisition and land matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
